parameters.description:
Relay a message to your own Flock by posting a native `flock` payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

`flock-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `flock` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Flock URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `token_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's Flock token).

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's flock token
